full_judgment:
6. Amiruddin predecessor of plaintiff Nos. 1-10 purchased 0.09 cents from khatian No. 9 by kabala from defendant No. 6 and also purchased 0.07 cents from defendant No. 6 by another kabala from khatian No. 9 by two more kabalas Amiruddin purchased 0.101/4 cents from defendant No. 2 from khatian No. 9. Nasiruddin purchased 0.083/4 cents from defendant No. 2 by kabala dated 7th Falgun 1359 BS from khatian No. 9. Thus Amiruddin and Nasiruddin by purchase got 0.35 cents in which plaintiffs have acquired interest in addition to the share already mentioned. Plaintiff Nos. 1-2 and 11-12 sold 0.54 cents of land to defendant No. 5 subject to an agreement for reconveyance. The property having not been partitioned by metes and bounds, great in convenience is left in the matter of enjoyment of property Title Suit No. 111 of 1947 was filed but the said suit was ultimately with drawn on 30-5-64 with permission to sue afresh, defendant No. 1 having not succeeded to amicable partition of the disputed property. Thus filed the instant suit for partition. 

 18. His further contention is that the CS record of schedule No. 1 prepared in the name of two sons of Tofani, Syed Ali and Amjad Ali as 6 annas share each and Hakimuddin for 4 annas share and Schedule-2 the khatian No. 40 stands in the name of Syed Ali and Amjad Ali for 4 annas shares to each and Hakimuddin for 8 annas shares and Schedule-3 appertains to khatian No. 152, stands in the names of Syed Amjad Ali and Hakimuddin as 1/3 share each, but the trial court held that the name of Hakimuddin was wrongly entered though it has not been challenged by the plaintiffs as such the findings of the trial court cannot be sustained. He prayed for allowing the appeal. 

 26. He deposed that Plaintiffs sold 0.54 cents of land to defendant No. 5 by kabala deed dated 20-5-67 subject to reconveyance and they filed partition suit No. 111 of 1947 which was decreed finally but the defendants filed objection under section 47 of the Code of Civil Procedure against the said decree on the ground that the decree was passed against dead person and accordingly the said decree was set-aside. Hence, this suit. He stated that it is not a fact that Tofani was the sole owner of schedule-1 and that they did not make any oral gift in favour of defendant No. 1. He deposed that it is not a fact that Rukubjan and Phuljan made oral gift before 1323 BS. He deposed that the CS Khatian was not proper and has interest of all co-shares and they are in ejmali possession and prayed for saham. 

 28. He has stated that it is not a fact that opposite party No.1 took bandabasta of 4 annas and Syed All and Amjad Ali 2 annas each and Tofani took bandabasta of 4. annas of scheduled-2 from the ex-landlords. It is not a fact that Mohammad All was the cousin (Mamato Bhai) of Tofani Talukdar. If is not a fact that Tofani gifted 4 annas interest to Abdul Hakim defendant No. 1 from schedule-I after the death of Mohammad Ali. The house of defendant No. 1 and their house are intervened by a Khal. It is not a fact that his father made tadbir at the time of CS operation. He stated that he had no knowledge that whose names the SA khatians have been prepared and did not take attempt to correct the SA khatian. He stated that it is not a fact that the sisters of defendant No. 1 gifted their property in his favour before CS operation and they are in possession of plot No. 271 and 272 and Plot Nos. 271 and 272 are bhitis and they purchased the same from Ayub All and Rahim Baksh and are in possession about 20 years. He stated that they have also possessed plot No. 285 and got it by purchased from Phuljan and Rupjan. He stated that it is not a fact that the kabalas are not correct and they have no possession in pursuance of kabalas and he stated that some of the documents were lost and damaged by rain water. 

 31. DW-1 Anwarullah Talukdar deposed that he is defendant No.I (Kha). Abdul Hakim Talukdar also known as Hakimuddin. He deposed that the Schedule-1 belonged to Mohammad Ali 4 annas khas, Tofani 4 annas and 8 annas and Khan Hakimuddin took settlement of 4 annas share. Syed All and Amajad Ali took bandabasta of 4 annas and schedule-3 belonged to the persons as alleged in the plaint. Mohammad Ali died in 1313 BS and at that time Hakimuddin was aged about 16/17 years. Tofani Talukdar looked after Hakimuddin during his minority. Rukubjan and Fuljan orally gifted their interest in favour of their brother Hakimuddin Talukdar and Tofani Talukdar accepted the gift on behalf of Hakimuddin Talukdar. Rupjan also orally gifted her interest in favour of Hakimuddin and Tofani gifted 4 annas interest of schedule-2 in favour of Hakimuddin before CS record. Hakimuddin had 4 annas in schedule-1 and 8 annas in schedule-2 and 1/3rd in schedule-3. He deposed that Amir Uddin Patwary got the interest recorded during the CS operation and he was a literate person of his relation. The kabalas in favour of the plaintiffs are fraudulent, collusive and bogus and were not acted upon. He deposed that the plaintiff earlier filed Title Suit for partition which was withdrawn by the plaintiffs and the grandsons of Tofani falsely filed this suit for harassing them. Karimjan and Alekjan relinquished their interest in favour of Syed Ali and Amjad Ali. It is not a fact that Mohammad Ali had 4 annas in schedule-1 and 8 arenas in schedule-2. It is not a fact that the CS Khatian was not correct. Rukubjan and her sisters never separated the homestead in dispute. 

 33. Md Nur Baksha Talukdar son of late Sayed Ali Talukder deposed as DW-2 on behalf of himself as defendant Nos. 4 and 5 on behalf of defendant Nos.1-4. He stated that Tofani had 12 annas in schedule-1 and 8 annas schedule-2 and 2/3rd in schedule-3 and Tofani died leaving sons Syed Ali and Amjad Ali and 2 daughters Karimajan and Alekjan who relinquished their interest in favour of Syed Ali and Amjad Ali. He deposed that defendant Nos. 2-5 are the heirs of Syed Ali who have 6 annas in schedule- 1, 4 annas in schedule-2, 5 annas, 6 Gands 2 Kara 2 Kranti in schedule-3. He denied that it is not a fact that Tofani gifted 4 annas of his interest in favour of Hakimuddin and Tofani had 4 annas interest in schedule-2 and 8 annas was in Khas of the Ex landlords. He deposed that it is not a fact that Hakimuddin took settlement of 4 annas by way of bandabasta. It is not a fact that his grandfather Tofani accepted gift on behalf of Rukubjan and her sister in favour of Hakimuddin. Defendant No. 5 purchased 0.54 cents of land from plaintiff No. 1 and defendant 5 is in possession of the same and deposed that the CS Khatian is correct.
